\section{MLOps Concepts}
\label{sec:mlops-concepts}

\subsection{Definition and Scope}
% [Member C] Define MLOps and distinguish it from DevOps and DataOps.

MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) is a set of practices that aims to deploy
and maintain machine learning models in production reliably and efficiently.
It extends DevOps principles to the ML context, introducing additional concerns
such as data versioning, experiment tracking, and model drift monitoring~\cite{alla2021mlops}.

\subsection{Key Components}
% [Member C] Describe each component (data pipeline, feature store, model registry, etc.)

\subsubsection{Data Pipeline}
The data pipeline automates the ingestion, validation, and transformation of
raw data into feature sets suitable for model training.
Key quality gates include schema validation and statistical distribution checks.

\subsubsection{Experiment Tracking}
Every training run is logged with its hyperparameters, metrics, and artefact
locations, enabling reproducibility and informed model selection.

\subsubsection{Model Registry}
The model registry is the single source of truth for versioned model artefacts.
It records lineage (which dataset and code produced a model) and governs
promotion through stages: \textit{staging} $\to$ \textit{production} $\to$ \textit{archived}.

\subsubsection{Serving Infrastructure}
Trained models are served via REST or gRPC endpoints.
The serving layer handles batching, scaling, and A/B routing.

\subsubsection{Monitoring and Observability}
Production models are monitored for data drift, concept drift, and performance
degradation.
Alerts trigger retraining pipelines automatically.

\subsection{MLOps Maturity Levels}
% [Member C] Describe the three maturity levels (manual, pipeline automation, CI/CD).

\begin{table}[ht]
\centering
\caption{MLOps maturity levels.}
\label{tab:maturity}
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}lX@{}}
\toprule
\textbf{Level} & \textbf{Characteristics} \\
\midrule
0 -- Manual     & Ad-hoc scripts; no versioning; manual deployment. \\
1 -- Pipeline   & Automated training pipelines; model registry in use. \\
2 -- CI/CD ML   & Automated testing, deployment, and monitoring loops. \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
\end{table}
